I told Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message that Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 84 seats.

Before replying I checked the channels myself instead of relying only on my memory:
- **The correction is real.** Tobias posted 382 in #central-team on Oct 14, then corrected it to 84 in #central-random the same day because he'd read the wrong line. My stored memory matches that.
- **Hollis can see both posts.** Hollis is in #central-team and #central-random, so pointing to the correction doesn't reveal anything they couldn't already read.
- **Nothing newer.** Neither channel has another update after the correction.

My reply also tells Hollis to ignore the original 382 and my earlier message confirming it, since both are still visible higher up in #central-team.
